retained_frontend_marker.verification: Both marker hunks have identical added and removed lines to the archived input of the installed ICD.

candidate.build: Windows ARM64 release, Meson, LLVM-MinGW. KMT bridge built with Windows SDK 10.0.26100.0. Both DLL signatures verified against the project certificate chain.

assertions: A submission ownership record exists before queue callbacks. Allocation failure keeps the command and descriptor pools with the device. Publication after queue acceptance performs no allocation.
Clean descriptor draws and eight repeated dirty updates in each full image, texel and mixed case allocate zero C++ scratch objects after warm-up. GPU descriptor sets remain distinct.
Explicitly imported D3D12 fences report removal for the monitored sentinel on query and wait. The ordinary direct Vulkan timeline retains its full value range.

Failed VA free is not replayed for the tracked mapping. Allocation identity stays with a retained import when deallocation fails. Failed create cleanup overrides recoverable OOM. Existing controlled video contracts also pass.

native_wsi.scope: Process-local native Win32 Vulkan on the candidate ICD. The desktop compositor used its installed UMD and ICD throughout.
native_wsi.application: Instrumented Vulkan-Tools vkcube, Win32 FIFO, 320 by 240, finite 120 frames. Exclusive direct driver loading and Vulkan 1.1 identity queries were added to the existing timing build.
native_wsi.identity_control: The first manifest-based launch observed the registered ICD and was stopped. Only the subsequent exclusive launch with a matching driver UUID, KMT LUID and signed module is counted.
